subject: rt-op
title: RT.OP.------SOC.RT.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 248 (CMBA-4). RT-OP (reality options) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: SPT-GH (spiritual growth), PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and PART (participation). From PROG-CONT: TRS (transition). From PART: INDIV-DY (individual dynamics). From INDIV-DY: POST (postulation). From POST: SF-RZ (self-realization) and SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics).
